segments.name: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc.
segments.description: Develops therapeutic products and medical therapies using cell and tissue protocols, primarily adult stem cells.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating and reporting segment (BioRestorative Therapies, Inc.) which develops therapeutic products and medical therapies using cell and tissue protocols, primarily involving adult stem cells.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay product sales for cosmetic units, and licensees pay usage-based royalties on the company's intellectual property.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is recognized as a usage-based royalty from customers' usage of intellectual property pursuant to a license agreement at the point in time in which the underlying sale occurs.
